description: This Java source file defines the WordsSQLiteConnection class, which manages SQLite database operations for a word dictionary, including creation, upgrades, and CRUD operations for words, within the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: Words
classes.description: A static inner class defining the column names for the words table in the database.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the words table in the database.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrades across versions.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Inserts a new word with its frequency into the database.

methods.name: deleteWord
methods.description: Removes a word from the database.

methods.name: loadWords
methods.description: Loads words from the database and passes them to a listener.
